scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:libs && tsc -p tsconfig.json && pnpm -r --parallel run typecheck
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:libs && eslint . && pnpm --filter @school/web run lint:fsd && prettier --check .
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run build:libs && vitest run --project unit
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run build:libs && vitest run --project integration
scripts.gen:openapi: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @school/api run build && pnpm --filter @school/api run gen:openapi
scripts.test:adversarial: pnpm run build:libs && vitest run --project adversarial
scripts.test:chaos: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm --filter @school/worker run build && vitest run --project chaos
scripts.gen:client: pnpm run gen:openapi && pnpm --filter @school/web run gen:client
